+import os
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
+
+
+def embed_platform_outputs(outputs: List[str], model: Optional[str] = None) -> List[List[float]]:
+    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    chosen_model = model or OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
+    response = requests.post(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings",
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": chosen_model, "input": outputs},
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return [item["embedding"] for item in sorted(data["data"], key=lambda x: x["index"])]
+
*** End Patch

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional

from openai import OpenAI


@dataclass
class PlatformResourceSelection:
    provider: str
    resource_type: str
    resource_id: str
    model: str
    client: Any

    resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
    model: Optional[str] = None,
    resource_type: Optional[str] = None,
) -> PlatformResourceSelection:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

    chosen_model = model or chosen_resource_id
    chosen_resource_type = resource_type or ("deployment" if os.environ.get("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") else "model")
    return PlatformResourceSelection(
        provider="openai",
        resource_type=chosen_resource_type,
        resource_id=chosen_resource_id,
        model=chosen_model,
        client=client,
    )

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional

from openai import OpenAI


@dataclass
class PlatformResourceSelection:
    provider: str
    resource_type: str
    resource_id: str
    model: str
    client: Any


def select_platform_resource(
    resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
    model: Optional[str] = None,
    resource_type: Optional[str] = None,
) -> PlatformResourceSelection:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
    chosen_resource_id = resource_id or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL") or os.environ.get("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") or "gpt-5.4-mini"
    chosen_model = model or chosen_resource_id
    chosen_resource_type = resource_type or ("deployment" if os.environ.get("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") else "model")
    return PlatformResourceSelection(
        provider="openai",
        resource_type=chosen_resource_type,
        resource_id=chosen_resource_id,
        model=chosen_model,
        client=client,
    )
